compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 assigns ADJ/GND (GND) whereas LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB assigns ADJ (ADJ) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VOUT pin (OUTPUT vs VOUT).
Functionally identical VIN pin (INPUT vs VIN).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs ADJ). Soldering LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB onto a AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL OUTPUT CONFIGURATION MISMATCH: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is fixed 3.3 V (p.7) whereas LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB is adjustable (Vref=1.25 V) (p.7); PCB resistor-divider footprint change is required.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 10 µF, p.3), whereas LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 103% higher on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: 125 °C/W p.4 vs LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.7) vs 2.65 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1: -20..125 °C Extended Commercial (-20°C to +125°C TJ — NOT -40°C Industrial) vs LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ, LM1117I grade)); AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 cold limit only -20 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs ADJ); fixed vs adjustable LDO feedback configuration mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs ADJ). Under a representative 5 V → 1.25 V rail at 150 mA (563 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 70.3 °C on AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 (θJA 125 °C/W) vs 34.6 °C on LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB (θJA 61.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2.4x ratio (4000 µA (p.7) vs 1700 µA (p.8)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 "Operating Temperature Stops at -20°C — NOT Rated for -40°C Industrial Grade" (p.4) and LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB "Pin 1 Is ADJ (NOT GND) — NEVER Drop Into Fixed 3.3 V / 5.0 V Footprints Without Feedback Resistors" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1 when your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors; choose LM1117IMPX-ADJ/NOPB when battery sleep budget demands 1700 µA Iq or lower package θJA (61.6 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
